title: x-capability
description: A specific security feature of a specific product or service, with how it is configured, audited, and remediated. Supports one or more implementation approaches. Defined by the CSA Security Controls Catalog.

vendor_namespace.description: Vendor namespace, mirroring the SecID namespace component (e.g. amazon.com, microsoft.com).

product.description: Product or service path, mirroring the SecID name component (e.g. aws/s3, azure/ai-content-safety).

config_snippet.description: How the capability is enabled. Keep thin and prefer pointing at the vendor's own documentation via external_references, since product detail changes on the vendor's release cadence.

newSdoExtension.description: Declares the object as a new SDO defined by a CSA extension-definition. The definition object must travel with the instance in any published bundle.
